notes: OEIS_A228095.A228095_conj: for every prime p = 5 mod 6 the p x p matrix ((i^2+3ij+3j^2)/p) has det 0; kernel vector v_j = (j/p), row sums reduce to sum chi(w^3-1) = 0 since cubing permutes F_p. Outside Lean: none (p = p_n reading; data by certificate/check.py).

sources.cite: H.-L. Wu, Elliptic curves over F_p and determinants of Legendre matrices, arXiv:2012.05746 (2021), Theorem 1.2(ii)
sources.what: [c,d]_p = 0 when p | A_{c,d}(p); with supersingularity of y^2 = x(3x^2+3x+1) at p = 2 mod 3 this gives the claim

prior_art.note: Follows from Wu 2021 plus a standard fact; explicit kernel vector and Lean proof are ours.
